# Contributing to AHT

Thank you for your interest in improving AHT, my personal portfolio built with Nuxt and Vue.

## Before you start

- Check the existing issues and pull requests to avoid duplicate work.
- For a significant change, open an issue first to discuss the proposed approach.
- Keep changes focused and avoid committing generated output or local environment files.

## Development workflow

1. Fork the repository or create a feature branch from `main`.
2. Install dependencies using the package manager and lockfile in the repository.
3. Run the development server and make your changes.
4. Run the available checks before opening a pull request:
   - `npm run build`
   - Any relevant linting or tests configured in `package.json`
5. Push your branch and open a pull request against `main`.

## Pull request checklist

- [ ] The change has a clear purpose and a descriptive title.
- [ ] The interface remains usable on mobile and desktop.
- [ ] Existing behavior outside the scope of the change is preserved.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or local environment files are included.
- [ ] Build and relevant checks have been run, or any limitation is explained.

## Reporting a bug

When opening an issue, include the steps to reproduce the problem, the expected behavior, the actual behavior, and relevant browser or device details.

## مشارکت در پروژه

از علاقه‌مندی شما برای بهبود AHT سپاسگزارم. لطفاً پیش از ارسال تغییرات، Issueها و Pull Requestهای باز را بررسی کنید. تغییرات را در یک شاخه مستقل انجام دهید، تا حد امکان Build و بررسی‌های مرتبط را اجرا کنید و هنگام ارسال Pull Request هدف تغییر و روش آزمایش آن را توضیح دهید.

مشارکت‌ها باید محدود، قابل بررسی و هماهنگ با ساختار فعلی پروژه باشند.
